hero.headline: Professional Services
hero.subheadline: Expert-led services spanning the full cybersecurity lifecycle — from assessment to operations

services.title: Security Assessment & Penetration Testing
services.description: Comprehensive vulnerability assessments and ethical hacking engagements to identify weaknesses before attackers do. Our certified penetration testers simulate real-world attack scenarios across your infrastructure, applications, and human layers.
deliverables: Penetration testing findings with CVSS scoring

processSteps.title: Scoping
processSteps.description: Define assessment scope, rules of engagement, and objectives.

processSteps.title: Reconnaissance
processSteps.description: Gather intelligence on target systems using OSINT and passive techniques.

processSteps.title: Testing
processSteps.description: Execute controlled attacks to identify exploitable vulnerabilities.

processSteps.title: Reporting
processSteps.description: Deliver comprehensive findings with risk ratings and remediation guidance.

processSteps.title: Remediation Support
processSteps.description: Assist teams in fixing identified issues and verify via re-testing.

services.title: Security Architecture & Design
services.description: Design and build a robust security architecture aligned with your business requirements and industry best practices. Our architects work with your teams to create blueprints that reduce risk and enable secure growth.

processSteps.title: Discovery
processSteps.description: Assess current infrastructure, tools, and security controls.

processSteps.title: Design
processSteps.description: Develop target architecture aligned to zero-trust principles.

processSteps.title: Validate
processSteps.description: Review architecture with stakeholders and refine requirements.

processSteps.title: Roadmap
processSteps.description: Create phased implementation plan with milestones and KPIs.

services.title: Incident Response & Forensics
services.description: Rapid and methodical incident response services to contain breaches, minimize damage, and restore normal operations. Our IR team is on standby 24/7 and can be deployed within hours of an alert.
deliverables: Forensic investigation and root cause analysis

processSteps.title: Detect & Triage
processSteps.description: Confirm the incident and assess its scope and severity.

processSteps.title: Contain
processSteps.description: Isolate affected systems to prevent further spread.

processSteps.title: Eradicate
processSteps.description: Remove the threat and close all attack vectors.

processSteps.title: Recover
processSteps.description: Restore systems and validate integrity before returning to production.

processSteps.title: Post-Incident
processSteps.description: Document findings and implement improvements.

services.title: Security Awareness Training
services.description: Transform your workforce into a human firewall with engaging, customized security awareness training programs. From phishing simulations to executive briefings, we build a security-first culture.

processSteps.title: Assess
processSteps.description: Evaluate current security awareness levels via baseline phishing test.

processSteps.title: Customize
processSteps.description: Tailor content to your industry, roles, and threat landscape.

processSteps.title: Train
processSteps.description: Deploy engaging training modules and simulations.

processSteps.title: Measure
processSteps.description: Track progress via metrics, quizzes, and simulation results.

services.title: Compliance & Regulatory Advisory
services.description: Navigate complex regulatory requirements with confidence. Our advisory team guides you through NCA ECC, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, SAMA CSF, and GDPR compliance programs, from gap analysis to certification.

processSteps.title: Gap Analysis
processSteps.description: Assess current controls against regulatory requirements.

processSteps.title: Planning
processSteps.description: Develop remediation plan with timelines and responsibilities.

processSteps.title: Implementation
processSteps.description: Support control implementation and documentation.

processSteps.title: Audit Readiness
processSteps.description: Prepare for compliance audits with mock assessments.

services.title: Onboard AI & Edge Computing Integration
services.description: We design and deploy high-performance onboard computing solutions for embedded and edge AI systems. Our focus is on transforming existing platforms into intelligent, mission-capable systems through seamless third-party hardware and software integration, enabling real-time perception, decision-making, and communication directly on-device without cloud dependency.
deliverables: Deployment of AI models on edge platforms
Real-time data processing and pipeline optimization
Low-latency performance tuning and system reliability optimization

processSteps.title: Platform Assessment
processSteps.description: Evaluate compute constraints, sensor stack, and mission requirements.

processSteps.title: Integration Design
processSteps.description: Define software architecture for model deployment, middleware, and data pipelines.

processSteps.title: Deployment & Tuning
processSteps.description: Deploy models on target hardware and optimize for latency, throughput, and reliability.

processSteps.title: Validation
processSteps.description: Validate real-time behavior under operational workloads and refine iteratively.

services.title: Robotics Architecture, Autonomy & Control
services.description: We engineer complete robotics systems from architecture to control execution, covering the full autonomy stack with tight coupling between perception, estimation, and control in real-time environments. Our systems are designed to be robust under real-world constraints and scalable across platforms.

processSteps.title: System Architecture
processSteps.description: Define modular robotics architecture, interfaces, and computational boundaries.

processSteps.title: Autonomy Stack Design
processSteps.description: Develop estimation, planning, and control pipelines for mission objectives.

processSteps.title: Embedded Implementation
processSteps.description: Implement and optimize autonomy components on real-time onboard hardware.

processSteps.title: Integration & Field Validation
processSteps.description: Validate full-stack behavior across simulation and live operational conditions.

services.title: System Integration & Validation
services.description: We integrate complex multi-vendor systems into cohesive, reliable platforms and verify performance under operational conditions. Our validation approach combines simulation, hardware-in-the-loop workflows, and real-world testing with iterative refinement.
deliverables: Integration of heterogeneous hardware and software systems
System debugging, profiling, and performance optimization

processSteps.title: Integration Planning
processSteps.description: Map subsystem interfaces, dependencies, and integration sequence.

processSteps.title: System Bring-Up
processSteps.description: Integrate heterogeneous components and establish stable communication baselines.

processSteps.title: HITL & Simulation Validation
processSteps.description: Stress-test behavior in controlled environments before field deployment.

processSteps.title: Operational Testing
processSteps.description: Execute field and flight tests, then optimize based on observed performance.
